oracle.body_rule: resistance line must be at or above every intervening candle body top; support line must be at or below every intervening candle body bottom
oracle.geometry: raw price and integer bar index
oracle.path_score: predecessor score plus current_index minus predecessor_index
oracle.pivot_tie_behavior: retain every candidate index whose value equals the inclusive-window max/min; no equal-pivot deduplication
oracle.winner_tie_behavior: dictionary insertion order with strict greater-than DP updates
